research.Title: Thermoacoustic Instability in Liquid Propellant Engines
research.OneLineDescription: Mesh-free CFD study of combustion dynamics and pressure oscillation mitigation.
research.Overview: Investigated thermoacoustic instabilities in liquid propellant rocket engines to identify mitigation strategies for pressure oscillations.
research.Methodology: Ran high-fidelity, mesh-free CFD of complex flow with frequency-domain analysis to isolate dominant instability modes.
research.ResultsOutcomes: Identified an acoustic coupling mechanism that informed a structural damping change, improving ignition stability.

projects.Title: Autonomous Sample-Return Rover
projects.OneLineDescription: Six-DOF sample collection rover built for the International Rover Design Challenge.
projects.Overview: Designed and built an autonomous rover for the ERC 2025 competition, focused on precision sample collection in simulated Martian terrain.
projects.DesignImplementation: Used ROS with OpenCV for autonomy, a custom 5-bar linkage for the collection arm, and a widefield imaging payload for spectral analysis.
projects.Challenges: Had to redesign the kinematic chain twice to meet the payload's precision tolerance while keeping the arm light enough for the drivetrain.

sideProjects.Title: Desk-Mounted CNC Plotter
sideProjects.OneLineDescription: A small pen-plotter built from scrap steppers to make technical drawings look hand-inked.
sideProjects.WhatItIs: A 2-axis pen plotter built over a weekend using salvaged stepper motors and a GRBL controller, mostly to see if I could get G-code working from scratch.
sideProjects.WhatILearned: First hands-on experience tuning stepper current limiting and learned to write basic G-code post-processors.
